message: We've all been there—lights flicker and suddenly, it's a family game of 'how do we survive this blackout?' I found a great resource that breaks down what to do when the power goes out, which is super helpful for keeping things smooth and calm with the kids. It's pretty reassuring to have a plan in place, even if it just means gathering everyone for a cozy candlelit snack. How do you keep the kids entertained during those unexpected dark moments?
